{"id":"8d3d8df7-6ffe-4397-b36c-68624d0fb92c","object":"chat.completion","created":1790510215,"model":"deepseek-flash","choices":[{"index":0,"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"{"parent_requirement_id": "R5", "mode": "residual", "used_claims": ["C1"], "local_residual": "Establish whether Alka Marwaha, the author of The Secret World of Vipassana and Mathematics, published a journal article on a topic similar to that book six years after the book's publication (i.e., around 2022), without yet fixing the article's title."}","reasoning_content":"We need answer JSON only. Need parse task. We have original question, parent requirement R5 source: "then published a journal article on a similar topic six years after publishing the book." Current Verified Claims C1, C2. Need identify exactly one coherent evidence objective inside Parent Requirement still needs established now. Must use verified claims if relevant. Parent requirement describes a relation: author published a journal article on similar topic six years after publishing the book. We need likely residual target: the journal article (title?) actually original asks title of article. Parent requirement R5 focuses on event of publishing journal article on similar topic six years after publishing book. Claims establish Alka Marwaha author of book "The Secret World of Vipassana and Mathematics" (2016). C2 about PhD. We need local residual: Establish that Alka Marwaha (or identified author) published a journal article on a similar topic (connecting mathematics to Vipassana/ancient technique for liberation?) six years after publishing the book. Since book published 2016, six years after = 2022? Wait original says book 20 years after PhD, article six years after book. C1 book date 2016. So article ~2022. But parent R5 only "then published a journal article on a similar topic six years after publishing the book." Need not solve title. We should ask evidence objective: whether Alka Marwaha published a journal article on a similar topic (Vipassana and mathematics) six years after the book. But if book date is C1, six years after 2016 = 2022. However "similar topic" relative to book. Need establish publication event and similar topic. Since title is downstream of identifying article. Do not jump to title? The original question asks title, but parent requirement R5 is publication event. The local residual could be "the identity/existence of a journal article by Alka Marwaha on a topic similar to The Secret World of Vipassana and Mathematics, published six years after the book (i.e., around 2022)." But must not output search query. Could mention relation: author published journal article on similar topic six years after publishing the book. Used claims C1 perhaps for book date and author. C2 irrelevant? Could use C1 to anchor author and book. C2 not needed. We can include "used_claims": ["C1"] or maybe ["C1","C2"]? Only Verified Claims count. The residual part: R5 has author (Alka Marwaha? not explicitly from original? C1 identifies book author, not necessarily same as original author? We have C3? No. C2 says Alka Marwaha PhD at Dalhousie. Original: Indian author got promoted... pursued PhD abroad at Canadian university under Iranian professor... published book... So C1/C2 connect Alka Marwaha to book and PhD, but not promotion. Parent R5 is about article after book. C1 establishes book and date and author. So used C1. The residual: whether Alka Marwaha published a journal article on a topic similar to Vipassana and mathematics six years after 2016. We don't know if "similar topic" = similar to book. Could phrase.

Need JSON only. Ensure schema: parent_requirement_id, mode, used_claims, local_residual. Mode residual because substantive supporting claim C1. local_residual should be one exploratory evidence objective. Not a search query. No answer. Let's craft.

Potential issue: "If some part of Parent Requirement already established by Claims, do not ask to establish that part again." C1 establishes book publication, author, topic. R5 includes "then published article ... six years after publishing book". The part "book" and author maybe established. Residual: journal article publication. Also "six years after publishing the book" can be calculated? Not evidence unless claim says published 2016. C1 gives date Nov 15 2016, so six years after is 2022. But the requirement is relation. Should we include temporal offset? Yes: article published six years after 2016. But if we ask "whether and which journal article..." that may be okay. It's an evidence objective, not search query. 

Need avoid "title" because parent requirement doesn't ask title. The original asks title, but parent requirement R5 source doesn't mention title. So don't jump to title. We can say "Establish that Alka Marwaha published a journal article on a topic similar to The Secret World of Vipassana and Mathematics six years after that book's publication (i.e., around 2022), without yet fixing its title." That's good. But is title downstream? Actually identifying article maybe includes title eventually, but parent requirement only publication. We can leave title for downstream.

Also "similar topic" between book and article. We need establish relation. "topic similar to the book" is part.

Should used_claims include C1 only. C2 doesn't support article. Good.

Final JSON."},"logprobs":null,"finish_reason":"stop"}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":824,"completion_tokens":1144,"total_tokens":1968,"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":384},"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":1052},"prompt_cache_hit_tokens":384,"prompt_cache_miss_tokens":440},"system_fingerprint":"aeb56401ca74e127821c4f9126dcb669"}
